Same with the content-visibility one for what is worth (we do [this](https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/rev/cb1060f7b4581e6c2d30f1accc84c7d807132d82/layout/style/res/details.css#5-11)), but I guess it doesn't matter much and it's not really observable. It's just less magic
